changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.25

Overlay customization and UI polish.

Overlay
- New "Transparent backgrounds" toggle (Settings > Overlay details): makes the timer, clears counter, module badges, app icon, and network monitor see-through to the game, keeping just the accent outline and text.
- The clears counter now has independent Raid and Dungeon toggles, so you can show raid only, dungeon only, both, or neither. The badge resizes to fit what you enable.

UI
- Widened buttons across Keybinds, Swaps, and Settings so long key combos and labels no longer get cut off with "...".
- Port and Swap mode in the Swaps window are now clean single-label toggle buttons that show the current value (no more cramped two-part pill).

No changes to packet logic or the 27k behavior.
